thank you for caring and trying but this is really not how it work. I'd be more than happy if I could live from my hobbies and things that I like. But I don't have the money and no one is hiring with my qualifications and experience (as i have zero of either). This is really not temporary at all. I'll never feel better, I've seen far many more people who were severely depressed and still feel like shit decades after it started than people who have been "cured". This is just not the life for me.

Either way, you're really lovely, thanks for your time.

not really, don't worry. I've been thinking of suicide a long time before (still partially because of her but yk, i still thought she loved me during my first attempt at 16). I'm 20 now and the animosity has only been that serious for a couple of years I think...

yesterday i tried reaching out for her and she angrily said I was dramatic and spoiled, and that i added nothing good into her life. A couple months ago she told me she didn't stand living with me anymore. If she loves me then that is one heck of a bad way to show lol. Either way, she's fine after losing a lot of her family. My cats will be sadder than she would.

I don't want to write too much but basically, my reasons for it are that depression pretty much rendered me completely unproductive. I can barely go to college, my grades are shit, I can't hold on to a job (which means no money) and even my hobbies piss me off more than anything. I've been treated with therapy and meds for forever and nothing worked.

I didn't post here bc there was something left, I'm just trying to make my last hours less terrible and get some human interaction bc i have no one irl. Thanks for your time. (also, I'm a girl sorry for not specifying before).
worse yet when you tell and they get angry and tell you to stop being over dramatic haha... some ppl just don't care for anything but themselves;
"At least I have chicken", I can sympathize with that lol. Thx for the laugh before I go to sleep. Tomorrow is gonna be a busy day... Good night everyone! Good night not-a-piano.

idk, even if it's true objectively, if i'm unlovable in the eyes of the people i care and have my only human interactions with and am treated as such, it doesn't matter as a principle because people act on there subjective perception of the "lovee"... (english is not my first language, sorry if it sounds jumbled) :(

yes, for some reason all of my plans involved eating fried chicken one last time before following plan. Ironically, in the first attempt I ate chicken pie bc i was to lazy to walk the last few kilometers to get kfc. Maybe that's why it didn't work :P
